name: Aldren Packmule Utility Cargo Pant
description:
Generous straight-fit cargo pants with an almost absurd number of pockets — ten total, including two drop-leg side pockets secured with both button and zip, two hidden interior thigh channels, and a sealed rear document pocket. Built from a mid-weight canvas-cotton blend in tan, olive, or dark navy.

Favored by field technicians, medics, and anyone whose job requires having the right thing in the right place immediately. The drop-leg pockets are the signature feature — they sit lower than standard cargo pockets, keeping bulk off the hip and making deep storage accessible while seated. Looks utilitarian. Is utilitarian.
functionality: Ten total pockets including drop-leg dual-secured pockets, hidden interior thigh channels, sealed rear document pocket
what_it_says: You carry a lot, you know where all of it is, and you've been caught without something important exactly once.
story_hooks: A medic's sealed document pocket contains paperwork that was supposed to have been destroyed — someone kept a copy.
The drop-leg pockets are deep enough that customs scanners at a Tier 4 checkpoint consistently miss what's at the bottom.

physical_description.visual_profile: Straight-leg silhouette with pronounced cargo architecture. Sits at natural waist with a relaxed, uncinched feel. The drop-leg pockets create a distinctive visual weight distribution, pulling the eye downward. Overall impression is practical and load-bearing—designed for someone who carries their livelihood on their person.
physical_description.fit: Generous straight-cut through hip and thigh with no taper. Accommodates layering and movement without restriction. Inseam runs full length to ankle. Cut to allow easy access to pockets while seated or crouched.
physical_description.primary_material: Mid-weight canvas-cotton blend—durable, breathable, and broken-in texture after wear. Resists snags better than pure cotton.
physical_description.texture: Slightly stiff when new with a matte finish; develops a soft, worn patina with use. Weave is visible under direct light, giving a tactile, industrial appearance.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in utilitarian tan, muted olive, or dark navy. Neutral palette designed for low visibility in industrial and field environments. Minimal branding.
physical_description.closures: Reinforced zip fly with button backup. Cargo pockets secured with both functional buttons and zippers to prevent loss during active work. Drop-leg pockets feature dual closure redundancy.
distinctive_features: Ten total pockets including two signature drop-leg side pockets positioned low on the thigh
Two hidden interior thigh channels for discrete small-item storage
Sealed rear document pocket with reinforced stitching
Heavy-duty stitching throughout, particularly at stress points
Cargo loops built for attachment hardware or tool tethering
Proportioned for someone carrying 5-8 kilograms of regular load
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional. Affordable enough for working-class deployment but engineered to last. Not aspirational; entirely practical.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by field technicians, combat medics, systems repair crews, and anyone in sub-contract labor that requires immediate access to tools or equipment. Signals 'I work with my hands and carry what I need.' Common sight in ungoverned zones and corpo field operations alike.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in with visible creasing at joints. Pockets show signs of heavy use—slight fraying at zipper pulls, minor stains from work environment. Some wear darkening around pocket openings from repeated hand access.
